Keep prior protected positions on their frozen exit contract; a true-hour EMA rollout must not silently change old position exits.
Acquire prospectively timestamped candidate/market/protection evidence and complete funding/cost data; current retrospective one-case trend result does not justify release.
Evaluate entry quality and residual exits separately across independent time periods; do not fit all gates to the same sample or permanently ban shorts from this cohort.
Only an explicit controlled SANDBOX release may enable a new execution contract; these research modules cannot place orders, change risk caps or promote themselves.
